questions.question: In which year was the Bharat Ratna award instituted?

• **Bharat Ratna** is the highest civilian honor in India.
 
• Any person without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex is eligible for these awards. 
 
• Bharat Ratna was instituted in the year** 1954.**
 
• It is **not mandatory** that Bharat Ratna be awarded every year.

• There is no written provision that Bharat Ratna should be awarded to Indian citizens only.

• **Indira Gandhi **was the first woman to get Bharat Ratna.
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar** is the first sportsperson to get Bharat Ratna.

questions.question: The Constitution under Article ______ mandates the Election Commission, to conduct elections to the Parliament and the State Legislatures.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**324.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **election commission** is a permanent and independent body established by the constitution of India.
 
• **Article 324** of the Indian constitution mandates the election Commission, to conduct elections to the Parliament and the State Legislatures.
 
• It is common to both the central government and the state government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea728f908b060e4db8cdc0f37188bd8bacc49aff99cc89b07517095538ec56de.png] 

 
• The Election Commission of India is not concerned with the elections to** panchayats and municipalities** in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Election Commission of India came into force on **25th January 1950.**
 
• The headquarters of the Election Commission is** Nirvachan Sadan**, located in New Delhi.
 
• The election commission consists of a chief election commissioner and two election commissioners.
 
• The election commissioners are appointed by the **president.**
 
• The tenure of election commissioners is **6 years or 65 years** of age, whichever is earlier.
 
• **Sukumar Sen** served as the first chief election commissioner of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 312** of the Constitution deals with the creation of one or more All India Services common to the Union and State.
 
• **Article 330** of the Constitution deals with the reservation of seats in the Lok Sabha for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
 
• **Article 298** of the Constitution deals with the power to carry on trade.

questions.question: The _________ is responsible for Earth's magnetic field.

__
 
• The interior of the earth is divided into three parts namely **Crust, Mantle, and Core.**
 
• **The core **is the innermost layer of the earth.
 
• The radius of the innermost layer(core) is about **3500 km.**
 
• The core is made up of material constituted by **nickel and iron.**
 
• The temperature and pressure of the central core are very high.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The core is further subdivided into two layers called the **outer core and inner core.**
 
• The outer core of the earth is in a liquid state.
 
• The inner core is in solid-state
 
• The outer core is responsible for the **earth's magnetic field.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It is brittle in nature.
 
• it the thinnest layer of Earth.
 
• The thickness of the crust varies under the oceanic and continental areas.
 
 
 
• **The mantle** is the second layer in the interior of the earth.
 
 
• The mantle extends from Moho’s discontinuity to a depth of 2,900 km.
 
• The upper portion of the mantle is called the asthenosphere.

questions.question: A higher _________ index represents inequality in income distribution.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gini.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gini index **measures the extent to which the distribution of income or consumption expenditure among individuals or households within an economy deviates from a perfectly equal distribution
 
• A Gini index of **0 represents perfect equality,** while an index of **100 implies perfect inequality.**
 
• A higher Gini index represents** inequality in income distribution.**
 
• As of 2011, the value for the Gini index estimated by the World Bank in India was **35.70.**
 
 
• India reached a minimum value of 31.70 in 1993.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• A **Lorenz curve **is used to represent income inequality or wealth inequality among countries.

 
 
• Lorenz curve was developed by** Max Lorenz **in 1905.
 
• Lorenz curve plots the cumulative percentages of total income received against the cumulative number of recipients, starting with the poorest individual or household.
 
• The Gini index measures the **area between the Lorenz curve**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• GDP stands for **Gross Domestic Product.**

 
 
• GDP is the value of all goods and services produced within a country during a given period.
 
 
 
• NDP stands for **Net Domestic Product.**
 
 
• NDP is equal to GDP minus depreciation.
 
 
 
• CPI stands for **Consumer Price Index.**
 
 
• CPI is a measure of the aggregate price level in an economy.

questions.question: In which medium does sound travel faster?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Solid.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sound waves are** longitudinal mechanical waves.**
 
• A **medium is necessary** for sound to travel.
 
• The speed of sound is different in different mediums.
 
• Sound travels **faster in solid mediums.**
 
• The speed of sound basically depends upon the elasticity and density of the medium.
 
• As the density of medium increases the speed of sound also increases.
 
• Speed of sound is **minimum in gases.**
 
• Sound waves cant travel through a** vacuum.**
 
• Speed of sound is independent of frequency.
 
• The study of sound is called **acoustics.**

__
 
• **Pandit Jasraj **was an Indian classical vocalist.
 
• International Astronomical Union (IAU) has named minor planet** 2006 VP32** (number -300128) in September 2019 after Pandit Jasraj.
 
• The planet is renamed as '**Panditjasraj**'
 
• The minor planet 2006 VP32 was discovered on 11th November 2006.
 
• The minor planet is located between **Mars and Jupiter.**
 
• Panditjasraj' minor planet has given the number **300128** in IAU's official website as his date of birth in reverse order (28/01/30).
 
• Pandit Jasraj has become the **first Indian musician **to get honoured with this unique recognition.

questions.question: Rambir Singh Khokar received the ‘Dronacharya award’ for:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kabaddi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rambir Singh Khokar** was a former Indian Kabaddi coach.

 
 
• He trained the Indian kabaddi team for the first-ever **Asian Kabaddi Championships** in 1987
 
• He was honoured with the **Dronacharya award in 2019.**
 
• He is the **fourth coach** in kabaddi to receive the prestigious Dronacharya award.
 
• Rambir Singh Khokhar retired from SAI in 2014.
 
• He trained **Patna Pirates** in the pro-Kabaddi League 2014 edition.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dronacharya award** is given by the government of India for excellence in sports coaching.

 
 
• Dronacharya award was instituted in **1985.**
 
• The award is named after "Guru Drona"
 
• Dronacharya award 2020 winners:
 
 
• 
 Dharmendra Tiwary (Archery).
 
 
• 
 Purushotham Rai (**Athletics**).
 
 
• 
 Shiv Singh (Boxing).
 
 
• 
 Romesh Pathania (Hockey).
 
 
• 
 Krishan Kumar Hooda (Kabaddi).
 
 
• 
 Vijay Bhalchandra Munishwar (Powerlifting).
 
 
• 
 Naresh Kumar (Tennis).
 
 
• 
 Om Parkash Dahiya (**Wrestling**).
